ui.rotation_suggested_note: Start with the required skills and energy ready. Repeat once the key skills are available again.
ui.rotation_missing_reaction: This lineup does not cover the suggested {reaction} setup. Follow the remaining steps.
ui.rotation_open_cycle: Start on field, then switch when Esper Cycle is ready.
ui.rotation_scorch: Enter with the Support Skill to apply Scorch.
ui.rotation_blackbird_combo: At A0, use Skill then Ultimate. With the extra Ultimate from A1 ready, use both Ultimates, then Skill.
ui.rotation_trigger_discord: Enter with the Support Skill after Blackbird to trigger Nova and combine it with Scorch for Discord.
ui.rotation_daffodill_break: Use Ultimate to mark the target with Insight, then Skill to build Break.
ui.rotation_zankou_burst: Use Redirect Skill to enter Illusion and prepare the enhanced combo. Use the Illusion Ultimate, return to Reality with the enhanced Skill, then use the empowered Reality Ultimate.
ui.rotation_prepare_psyche: Use Ultimate and Skill to prepare the Psyche setup.
ui.rotation_trigger_nova: Enter with the Support Skill when Esper Cycle is ready to trigger Nova.
ui.rotation_lacrimosa_nova: Build Basic Attack stacks, then use Ultimate and Anomaly Skill during the Nova sequence.
ui.rotation_blackbird_repeat: Stay on Blackbird or switch back, then use Basic Attacks until her Skill is ready again.
ui.rotation_akane_burst: Use Ultimate, then tap Redirect Skill for one target or hold it for an area. Build 30 String Energy with Basic Attacks, cast Synced Resonance, then use the second Ultimate before Solo Cadenza ends.
ui.rotation_akane_blackbird_finish: At A0, switch back after Akane’s combo to spend the remaining Malice.
ui.rotation_nanally_incantation: Prepare Esper Cycle, then switch to Nanally with her Support Skill to trigger Hexed.
ui.rotation_nanally_burst: Use Redirect Skill, then Ultimate. Stay on field and use Basic Attacks during Ichi-daime’s Authority.
ui.rotation_hotori_record: Use Present Replay, then record allied Redirect or Support Skills during the next 5 seconds.
ui.rotation_hotori_cosmos: Use Redirect Skill, then switch to the Anima ally when Esper Cycle is ready.
ui.rotation_hotori_anima: Enter with the Support Skill to trigger Blossom and record it during Present Replay.
ui.rotation_hotori_burst: When the Timepiece is full, use World’s Tide to replay the recorded skills. Build stacks with Basic Attacks, then use the Ultimate finisher.
ui.rotation_discord_incantation: Prepare Esper Cycle, then switch to the active damage dealer to apply Scorch.
ui.rotation_discord_psyche: Enter with the Support Skill when Esper Cycle is ready to apply Nova and combine it with Scorch for Discord.
ui.rotation_baicang_burst: Apply your damage-over-time effects with Skill, then use Ultimate and follow up with enhanced plunging attacks when available.
ui.rotation_lacrimosa_burst: Build 10 Nightmare stacks with Basic Attacks, then use Ultimate and Anomaly Skill.
ui.rotation_chaos_cosmos: Prepare Esper Cycle, then switch to Chaos with the Support Skill to trigger Remora.
ui.rotation_chaos_burst: Apply Warrant with Doubtmark, build Crime, then use Ultimate and spend Crime with held attacks during Dread Echo.
ui.rotation_shinku_stacks: Build maximum stacks, use Skill, then build back to four stacks.
ui.rotation_shinku_lakshana: Use Ultimate, then Skill to prepare the Charge sequence.
ui.rotation_shinku_cosmos: Use Ultimate, then Skill after the Lakshana ally.
ui.rotation_shinku_anima: Use Ultimate, then Skill to complete the Charge setup. Switch once the Skill starts.
ui.rotation_shinku_burst: Use Ultimate, then Skill up to five times.
ui.rotation_burst_assumptions: Start with the required skills and energy ready. Longer modeled buffs go first. Durations start when each effect triggers.
ui.rotation_no_setup: No supported temporary team buffs to schedule for this build.
ui.rotation_burst_finish: Return to the active character and use their Ultimate once it is ready. Exact overlap depends on swaps, animations, and impact timing.
ui.with_all_buffs_help: Projection with modeled personal and compatible team effects active. Ranking and objectives use the normal build stats.
ui.team_warning_projection_unavailable: The temporary team buff projection could not be calculated.
ui.team_warning_missing_rank_parameter: A team bonus was skipped because its exact Arc rank data is missing.
ui.team_warning_mixed_rank_priority_unknown: A team bonus was skipped because eligible Arcs have different ranks and their priority is unknown.
ui.team_warning_multiple_sources_unsupporte: A team bonus was skipped because several eligible Arc copies provide it.
ui.team_warning_unsupported_rule: An Arc team effect is unavailable in this projection.

ui.damage_unavailable: Damage data is not available for this character.

ui.scan_recovery_warning: This stops all active Pktmon data collection on Windows, including captures started by other tools, then starts a new guided scan. Use it only when a scan is stuck.
ui.scan_recovery_button: Stop Pktmon and retry the scan

ui.scan_privacy: Raw captures are deleted automatically after import. Only the validated export remains in workspace/scan-output on this PC. The optimizer does not upload any data.
ui.scan_step_admin: Click Start guided scan and approve the Windows administrator prompt. Only the small capture helper is elevated.
ui.scan_step_import: Wait for completion: the capture is decoded, validated, then imported automatically into the optimizer.
ui.scan_step_login: When the console says the capture is ready, click Login in NTE and let loading complete.
ui.scan_step_ready: Open NTE and stay on the screen where the Login button is visible, without clicking it.
ui.scan_waiting: The scanner is running. Approve the Windows prompt, then click Login when the console says the capture is ready.
ui.scorch_note: Scorch uses the level 80 base (2,700), cycle intensity, up to 3 stacks with Zankou and a fixed 50% CRIT. It does not use ATK or universal damage.
